name: 王之政
objective:
共分車用電機 (含車用直流馬達、感應馬達、同步馬達及其驅動器介紹，馬達位置、轉速及扭矩控制)、車用電池技術 (含電池分類、電池化學、電池檢驗及測試、新式電池及燃料電池)、充放電系統 (發電機、充放電特性)、車輛電能管理四部份內容。
This course includes 4 parts: Vehicle electrical motor (DC Motor, Induction Motor, Synchronous Motor, and Motor Actuator, Control of Position, Speed, and Torque), Vehicle battery technology (battery types, electro-chemical technology, testing, alternative batteries, and fuel cell), Charging system (generator and charging characteristics), and Electrical energy management system.
